summary.text: Tom Gerhold, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Gerhold, is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 84 who has served in the Iowa House since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a research associate at the University of Iowa Carver College of Medicine.

paragraphs.text: Tom Gerhold was born in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and graduated from Benton Community High School.
His career experience includes working as a research associate with the Department of Internal Medicine at the University of Iowa Carver College of Medicine.
Gerhold won Iowa House District 75 in the November 6, 2018 general election, defeating Paula Denison and John George, and was re-elected there in 2020 over Ruby Bodeker.
In the redrawn District 84 he defeated Sara Yedlik in 2022 and Ashley Meredith in 2024.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him as vice chair of the Environmental Protection Committee and assigned to the House Agriculture, Labor, House Veterans Affairs and International Relations committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Polly Denison in the general election.
